description: A named shared resource that only one session or helper can use at a time (a dev window that allows a single instance, plasmashell, a port). claim it before you or a helper start something that needs it: refused, saying who holds it, since when and why, when someone else has it; then do not start it, do other work and try again later (nothing waits for you). Claiming your own again refreshes its time. It frees itself after `minutes` (30 unless given, at most 240) from the last claim, when its Session ends, or when you release it. A helper usually cannot call Progressor: claim on its behalf with label such as 'helper: media run'. release it as soon as the work that needed it ends (a helper's too), with the same label; another holder's is refused unless force, only when the Developer says the holder is gone. list says who holds what (get_status shows the same).

force.description: To release: even though someone else holds it. Only when the Developer asks.

label.description: Who it is held for when that is not this Session itself, such as 'helper: media run'. Claim and release a helper's lock with the same label.

minutes.description: To claim: how long to keep it before it frees itself, from now. 30 if omitted; claim again to extend.

reason.description: To claim: why you need it, in a few words, such as 'running the UI test'. Shown to whoever is refused.

resource.description: The shared thing's name, such as 'dev-window' or 'plasmashell'. Case and spaces do not matter.

task.description: To claim: the Task ID it is for, such as 't3'.

name: resource
title: Shared resource
